recipes.title: Spanish Pan con Tomate with Extra-Virgin Olive Oil
recipes.summary: Beloved Mediterranean morning toast rubbed lightly with garlic, spooned with sweet grated ripe tomato, and drenched in fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Grate the cut side of a ripe tomato over a box grater into a bowl, leaving the skin behind.
Toast bread until crisp and rub the warm surface once gently with the cut side of a garlic clove.
Spoon grated tomato over the toast, drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil, and finish with sea salt and basil.
tips: Grating the tomato makes a soft, juicy topping that softens crusty toast slightly for easier chewing.
Use your freshest, peppery extra-virgin olive oil here since it is the star flavor.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt with Extra-Virgin Olive Oil, Honey & Figs
recipes.summary: Classic Aegean breakfast bowl combining thick plain Greek yogurt, fruity extra-virgin olive oil, warm honey, sliced figs, and walnuts.
steps: Spoon Greek yogurt into a shallow bowl and make shallow swirls across the top with the back of a spoon.
Drizzle extra-virgin olive oil and honey into the swirls.
Top with quartered figs, chopped walnuts, and fresh lemon zest.
tips: Extra-virgin olive oil turns simple yogurt remarkably lush and velvety.
Ripe peaches, berries, or sliced banana substitute seamlessly when figs are out of season.

recipes.title: Savory Olive Oil Rolled Oats with Soft Egg & Spinach
recipes.summary: Warm, comforting savory oatmeal cooked in broth with wilted spinach, crowned with a soft-cooked egg and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Simmer rolled oats in vegetable broth 6 to 7 minutes until creamy, then fold in baby spinach until wilted.
Meanwhile gently fry or poach an egg in 1 tsp olive oil until whites are set and yolk stays soft.
Spoon savory oats into a warm bowl, top with the egg, Parmesan, black pepper, and the remaining 2 tsp extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Savory olive oil oatmeal eats like quick risotto with half the effort.
A soft runny yolk mixes with extra-virgin olive oil to make a silky natural sauce.

recipes.title: Warm Olive Oil White Beans, Greens & Poached Egg
recipes.summary: Creamy cannellini beans warmed in extra-virgin olive oil, garlic, and rosemary, nestled under gently poached eggs.
steps: Warm 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil over medium-low heat; cook garlic and rosemary 30 seconds, then stir in cannellini beans, 1/4 cup water, and spinach.
Make two small wells in the warm beans, crack an egg into each well, cover, and cook 4 to 5 minutes until whites are set.
Finish off the stove with the remaining 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil and a bright squeeze of lemon.
tips: Simmering eggs right in the bean skillet means only one pan to wash.
Great for steady morning fiber and protein.

recipes.title: Tender Olive Oil & Lemon Ricotta Skillet Pancakes
recipes.summary: Cloud-light Italian-style ricotta pancakes made moist with fruity extra-virgin olive oil and fragrant fresh lemon zest.
steps: Whisk ricotta, eggs, milk, extra-virgin olive oil, and lemon zest until smooth.
Fold in whole-wheat flour and baking powder just until combined.
Cook 1/4-cup rounds on a lightly oiled skillet over medium-low heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until lightly golden.
tips: Extra-virgin olive oil keeps these pancakes unbelievably tender without needing butter.
Serve with fresh blueberries or warm stewed berries.

recipes.title: Tuscan White Bean, Tuna & Extra-Virgin Olive Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Classic Italian lunch pairing flaky olive-oil-packed tuna, creamy cannellini beans, red onion, parsley, lemon, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Combine rinsed cannellini beans, flaked tuna, finely diced red onion, and chopped parsley in a bowl.
Drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil and fresh lemon juice.
Season with cracked black pepper and toss gently so the beans stay creamy and intact.
tips: Rinse finely diced red onion under cold water for 10 seconds to mellow its bite.
Swap tuna for extra chickpeas or artichoke hearts for a plant-based plate.

recipes.title: Horiatiki Greek Village Salad with Generous Olive Oil
recipes.summary: Sun-ripened tomatoes, crisp cucumber, olives, oregano, and creamy feta dressed the authentic Greek way in abundant extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Arrange tomato wedges, sliced cucumber, and pitted olives in a shallow serving bowl.
Place feta cheese on top and sprinkle generously with dried oregano.
Drizzle red wine vinegar and abundant extra-virgin olive oil over everything and let sit 5 minutes for the juices to mingle.
tips: Dip a slice of whole-grain bread into the tomato-olive oil juices at the bottom—that is the best part.
Use ripe cherry tomatoes out of summer season for reliable sweetness.

recipes.title: Warm Olive Oil-Braised Lentils & Wilted Escarole
recipes.summary: Hearty green lentils simmered briefly with garlic, lemon zest, leafy greens, and a generous swirl of fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Warm 1 tbsp olive oil gently over medium-low heat and infuse sliced garlic and thyme for 1 minute without browning.
Add cooked lentils and vegetable broth and simmer 5 minutes until warm and brothy.
Fold in leafy greens until wilted, remove from heat, and finish with lemon juice and the remaining 1 1/2 tbsp cold-pressed olive oil.
tips: Finishing cooked legumes with raw extra-virgin olive oil boosts aroma and polyphenol freshness.
Canned or vacuum-packed pre-cooked lentils make this a 15-minute hot lunch.

recipes.title: Velvety Roasted Tomato & Extra-Virgin Olive Oil Soup
recipes.summary: Silky, dairy-free Mediterranean tomato soup blended with extra-virgin olive oil until naturally creamy and rich without heavy cream.

ingredient_details.item: crushed San Marzano or fire-roasted tomatoes

steps: Soften onion and garlic gently in 1 tbsp olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth and simmer gently 10 minutes.
Remove from heat, add basil and remaining 2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, and blend thoroughly until velvety orange-red and naturally creamy.
tips: Emulsifying extra-virgin olive oil directly into hot tomato soup creates lush body with zero cream and helps absorb lycopene.
Serve with whole-grain croutons or soft bread.

recipes.title: Smashed Olive Oil Chickpea & Roasted Pepper Wrap
recipes.summary: No-mayo Mediterranean chickpea salad smashed creamy with extra-virgin olive oil, lemon, parsley, and sweet roasted red peppers.
steps: Mash chickpeas roughly with extra-virgin olive oil and lemon juice until creamy yet textured.
Fold in diced roasted red peppers, chopped parsley, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Spread onto whole-wheat tortillas with baby spinach, roll snugly, and slice in half.
tips: Extra-virgin olive oil binds smashed chickpeas cleanly without mayonnaise.
Jarred roasted peppers are soft, sweet, and save chopping.

recipes.title: Olive Oil-Poached Cod with Lemon, Garlic & Cherry Tomatoes
recipes.summary: Silky, melt-in-your-mouth white fish gently baked in fragrant extra-virgin olive oil with sweet cherry tomatoes, lemon slices, and thyme.
steps: Heat oven to 325 F. Arrange cod fillets, cherry tomatoes, sliced garlic, lemon slices, and thyme snugly in a small baking dish.
Pour extra-virgin olive oil over the fish and tomatoes and bake gently 12 to 14 minutes until fish flakes effortlessly with a spoon.
Finish with chopped parsley and spoon the fragrant tomato-infused olive oil over the plated fish.
tips: Gentle low-oven olive oil poaching keeps cod extraordinarily moist and prevents overcooking.
Save any leftover aromatic baking oil to drizzle over steamed vegetables or bread.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon, Oregano & Olive Oil Sheet-Pan Chicken
recipes.summary: Tender chicken thighs roasted alongside baby potatoes and zucchini in classic Greek extra-virgin olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F and whisk extra-virgin olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano in a small bowl.
Toss chicken thighs and halved baby potatoes with two-thirds of the marinade on a lined sheet pan and roast 15 minutes.
Toss zucchini with remaining marinade, add to the pan, and roast 10 more minutes until chicken reaches 165 F and veggies are golden.
tips: Adding zucchini halfway keeps it tender-crisp rather than watery.
Drizzle an extra spoonful of fresh uncooked extra-virgin olive oil on plates right before eating.

recipes.title: Whole-Wheat Pasta Aglio e Olio with Tender Broccoli
recipes.summary: Timeless Italian pantry supper emulsifying golden garlic-infused extra-virgin olive oil with pasta water, tender broccoli florets, and lemon.
steps: Boil pasta according to package directions, adding broccoli florets during the final 3 minutes; reserve 1/2 cup starchy cooking water.
Meanwhile gently warm extra-virgin olive oil and sliced garlic in a skillet over low heat 2 minutes until fragrant and pale gold.
Toss drained pasta, broccoli, and splashes of cooking water into the oil until silky, finishing with lemon zest, parsley, and Parmesan.
tips: Boiling broccoli in the pasta water saves a pot and guarantees tender florets.
Keep skillet heat gentle so the garlic turns sweet instead of bitter.

recipes.title: Silky Olive Oil-Braised Zucchini, Eggplant & Tomato Stew
recipes.summary: Classic Provencal ratatouille gently stewed in fragrant extra-virgin olive oil until spoon-soft, served over warm polenta or white beans.
steps: Warm 2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil over medium heat and saute eggplant, zucchini, and bell pepper for 7 minutes until beginning to soften.
Stir in garlic, thyme, and diced tomatoes; cover and simmer gently 15 minutes until meltingly tender.
Remove from heat and swirl in the remaining 1 tbsp fresh extra-virgin olive oil before ladling into warm bowls.
tips: Ratatouille tastes even richer the next day and reheats smoothly.
Top with a poached egg or serve beside grilled salmon for extra protein.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon & Olive Oil-Whipped Yukon Gold Potatoes
recipes.summary: Butter-free creamy Yukon Gold potatoes whipped with fruity extra-virgin olive oil and roasted garlic alongside flaky herb-baked salmon.
steps: Boil Yukon Gold potatoes and peeled garlic cloves 14 minutes until very tender, reserving 1/4 cup cooking water.
Meanwhile brush salmon with 1 tbsp olive oil, rosemary, and lemon juice and bake at 400 F for 12 minutes until flaky.
Mash hot potatoes and soft garlic smooth with remaining 2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil and splashes of potato water; serve with salmon and steamed spinach.
tips: Boiling whole garlic cloves right with the potatoes turns them sweet and buttery without roasting.
Yukon Golds mash silky with extra-virgin olive oil alone—no dairy required.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Blueberry, Orange & Olive Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Lush antioxidant smoothie blending frozen blueberries, Greek yogurt, fresh orange, and a silky spoonful of fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Pour milk, orange juice, Greek yogurt, and extra-virgin olive oil into a blender.
Add frozen blueberries, honey, and orange zest.
Blend 45 seconds until luxuriously smooth and frosty.
tips: A mild, buttery extra-virgin olive oil gives smoothies gelato-like richness alongside sweet citrus and berries.
Omit honey if using very sweet navel oranges.

recipes.title: Silky Avocado, Spinach, Lemon & Olive Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright, ultra-creamy green smoothie pairing avocado, baby spinach, banana, fresh lemon, oat milk, and cold-pressed extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Blend oat milk and baby spinach 20 seconds until completely smooth.
Add avocado, frozen banana, lemon juice, and extra-virgin olive oil.
Blend 35 seconds until velvety pale green and serve cold.
tips: Olive oil's subtle grassy notes blend right into lemon and leafy greens.
Add 4 ice cubes if using a room-temperature banana.

recipes.title: Italian Strawberry, Basil & Extra-Virgin Olive Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing Italian summer flavor combining frozen strawberries, fresh basil leaves, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Place almond milk, Greek yogurt, extra-virgin olive oil, frozen strawberries, basil leaves, and honey in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until smooth, rosy, and aromatic.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Strawberries, sweet basil, and extra-virgin olive oil are a beloved Italian dessert trio.
Start with 4 basil leaves if you prefer a gentle herbal accent.

recipes.title: Italian Dark Chocolate, Banana & Olive Oil Velvet Shake
recipes.summary: Decadent-tasting yet wholesome smoothie pairing frozen banana, cocoa, oat milk, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil inspired by Spanish chocolate con aceite.
steps: Combine oat milk, extra-virgin olive oil, frozen banana, cocoa powder, vanilla, and a tiny pinch of sea salt in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until thick, rich, and silky smooth.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Dark chocolate, flaky salt, and extra-virgin olive oil is a classic Spanish snack combination.
Naturally dairy-free and sweetened solely by ripe banana.

recipes.title: Sunlit Peach, Oat & Extra-Virgin Olive Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunny golden smoothie blending frozen peaches, rolled oats, milk, vanilla, and a velvety tablespoon of extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Add milk, rolled oats, extra-virgin olive oil, frozen peaches, vanilla, and cinnamon to a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until frothy and smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy.
tips: Olive oil replaces nut butter gracefully for an allergy-friendly creamy smoothie.
Frozen mango or apricots swap in effortlessly for peaches.

recipes.title: Sipping Andalusian Tomato, Cucumber & Olive Oil Juice
recipes.summary: Traditional Southern Spanish chilled sipping gazpacho blended thin and strained smooth with ripe tomato, cucumber, vinegar, and extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Blend tomatoes, peeled cucumber, bell pepper, vinegar, chilled water, extra-virgin olive oil, and a pinch of salt for 1 minute until frothy.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve for a clean, silky sipping juice.
Serve ice-cold in glasses right away.
tips: In Andalusia, light smooth gazpacho is famously served chilled in a drinking glass on warm afternoons.
Emulsifying olive oil into the tomatoes maximizes lycopene absorption.

recipes.title: Sicilian Carrot, Orange & Extra-Virgin Olive Oil Press
recipes.summary: Bright Sicilian citrus-carrot juice shaken smooth with a fruity teaspoon of cold-pressed extra-virgin olive oil and a hint of rosemary.

ingredient_details.item: freshly squeezed blood or navel orange juice

steps: Combine carrot juice, freshly squeezed orange juice, lemon juice, and extra-virgin olive oil in a jar.
Shake briskly 10 seconds to create a velvety emulsion.
Pour over ice and garnish with a fragrant sprig of rosemary.
tips: Blood oranges give gorgeous ruby color when available in winter, while sweet navel oranges work all year.
The teaspoon of extra-virgin olive oil unlocks fat-soluble carotenoids in carrot juice.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Lemon, Ginger & Olive Oil Morning Press
recipes.summary: Traditional Mediterranean morning citrus tonic shaking freshly squeezed lemon, sweet apple juice, ginger, and extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Pour fresh lemon juice, apple juice, cold water, ginger juice, and extra-virgin olive oil into a lidded jar.
Shake vigorously 10 seconds until emulsified and lightly foamy.
Pour into a glass and drink fresh.
tips: Apple juice softens the sharp tartness of lemon while keeping this morning tonic crisp and refreshing.
Use a gentle mild olive oil if you dislike strong peppery finishes.

recipes.title: Crisp Green Apple, Celery & Olive Oil Garden Press
recipes.summary: Clean green garden press uniting celery juice, crisp green apple juice, lime, and a grassy teaspoon of extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Combine fresh celery juice, green apple juice, lime juice, and extra-virgin olive oil in a lidded jar.
Shake briskly 10 seconds until silky and unified.
Pour into a chilled glass and garnish with parsley.
tips: Grassy extra-virgin olive oil naturally echoes green apple and crisp garden celery.
Drink chilled over two ice cubes on warm afternoons.

recipes.title: Ruby Pomegranate, Orange & Olive Oil Polyphenol Tonic
recipes.summary: Jewel-bright pomegranate and fresh orange juice shaken smooth with a silky teaspoon of polyphenol-rich extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Shake pomegranate juice, fresh orange juice, cold water, and extra-virgin olive oil in a jar for 10 seconds.
Pour over ice into a tall glass.
Garnish with fresh spearmint leaves and enjoy immediately.
tips: Both pomegranate and extra-virgin olive oil bring vibrant Mediterranean polyphenols to one bright glass.
Diluting slightly with cold water keeps the tartness gentle and easy to sip.

recipes.title: Extra-Virgin Olive Oil, Sweet Orange, Rosemary & Blueberry Ricotta
recipes.summary: Mediterranean whipped ricotta drenched in fruity extra-virgin olive oil, sweet orange segments, fresh blueberries, and a whisper of minced rosemary.
steps: Fluff ricotta with fresh orange zest and divide between two morning bowls.
Arrange orange segments and fresh blueberries over top and sprinkle with finely minced rosemary and a tiny pinch of black pepper.
Drizzle generously with fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Good polyphenol-rich extra-virgin olive oil shines raw over creamy dairy and citrus.
Zero cooking required.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Olive Oil, Banana, Cinnamon & Cherry Barley Bowl
recipes.summary: Creamy quick-cooking pearl barley gently cooked with mashed banana, cinnamon, halved sweet cherries, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Simmer quick barley, milk, mashed banana, quartered cherries, and ground cinnamon 10 to 12 minutes until soft and velvety.
Ladle into two warm breakfast bowls.
Finish with a lush drizzle of fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Olive oil brings Mediterranean bakery aroma to warm banana-cinnamon barley.
Soft, warm, and deeply comforting.

recipes.title: Olive Oil-Poached Soft Eggs with Flaked Salmon, Celery & Thyme
recipes.summary: Silky gentle-heat scrambled eggs cooked in extra-virgin olive oil with finely diced celery stalk, flaked poached salmon, fresh thyme, and black pepper.
steps: Soften very finely diced celery stalk and fresh thyme in 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil 3 minutes over gentle heat.
Pour in whisked eggs and black pepper, folding slowly until soft creamy curds form.
Fold in flaked salmon off the heat and finish with remaining olive oil.
tips: Cooking eggs gently in extra-virgin olive oil creates pillowy richness with zero butter.
High-protein omega-3 breakfast.

recipes.title: Extra-Virgin Olive Oil, Dark Chocolate, Red Grape & Sea Salt Yogurt
recipes.summary: Spanish-inspired morning Greek yogurt crowned with halved red grapes, finely shaved 70% dark chocolate, ground anise seed, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Spoon thick Greek yogurt into two bowls and dust lightly with ground anise seed.
Top with halved red grapes and finely shaved 70% dark chocolate.
Finish with fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Olive oil and dark chocolate are a celebrated Mediterranean duo—anise seed adds subtle bakery sweetness.
Zero cooking needed.

recipes.title: Golden Olive Oil, Turmeric, Saffron & Orange Soft Oat Cakes
recipes.summary: Tender sunlit banana-oat cakes scented with orange zest, saffron, golden turmeric, grated ginger, and extra-virgin olive oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange zest plus 2 tbsp juice

steps: Whisk mashed banana, eggs, quick oats, saffron orange juice, zest, turmeric, grated ginger, a pinch of black pepper, and 1 tbsp olive oil.
Brush a warm skillet with remaining olive oil and cook small tender cakes 2 minutes per side.
Serve warm with yogurt or fresh berries.
tips: Olive oil makes griddle cakes extraordinarily moist inside.
Saffron and orange fill the kitchen with sunny aroma.

recipes.title: Gentle Olive Oil-Poached Salmon with Fennel Seed, Celery & Orange
recipes.summary: Silky low-temperature salmon fillets softly poached in extra-virgin olive oil with crushed fennel seed and orange zest, served over thinly sliced celery stalk.
steps: Place salmon fillets in a small snugly fitted baking dish with extra-virgin olive oil, crushed fennel seed, orange zest, and black pepper.
Bake gently at 300°F for 13 to 15 minutes until salmon is custard-tender and flakes effortlessly.
Serve over thinly sliced peeled celery stalk and sweet orange segments, spooning a little fragrant oil over top.
tips: Low-heat olive oil poaching yields the most tender, melt-in-the-mouth salmon possible.
Save any leftover aromatic oil for salad dressing.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Olive Oil, Chicken, Barley, Sweet Basil & Sumac Bowl
recipes.summary: Bright midday grain salad tossing cooled cooked pearl barley, shredded poached chicken, diced celery stalk, fresh sweet basil, tangy sumac, and olive oil.
steps: Whisk extra-virgin olive oil, fresh orange juice, and ruby sumac.
Fold in cooled pearl barley, shredded poached chicken, finely diced celery stalk, and torn sweet basil.
Toss gently and serve chilled or room temperature.
tips: High-polyphenol olive oil ties every Mediterranean herb and grain together.
Makes two effortless lunches.

recipes.title: Velvety Olive Oil, Turmeric, Cumin & Rosemary White Bean Bowl
recipes.summary: Smooth warm white bean puree whipped with extra-virgin olive oil, golden turmeric, cumin, minced rosemary, black pepper, and finely diced celery stalk.
steps: Warm 1 tbsp olive oil with finely minced rosemary, turmeric, cumin, and black pepper 30 seconds.
Add white beans and warm broth, heating gently 3 minutes, then mash or blend silky smooth.
Swirl into bowls, top with remaining extra-virgin olive oil and finely diced celery, and serve with soft pita.
tips: Silky bean mash glides down easily and delivers steady plant protein.
Fruity olive oil pools beautifully on top.

recipes.title: Chilled Cantaloupe, Red Grape, Tarragon & Olive Oil Chickpea Salad
recipes.summary: Refreshing no-cook lunch pairing ripe cantaloupe, halved red grapes, soft chickpeas, fresh tarragon, spearmint, black pepper, and extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Combine soft chickpeas, ripe cantaloupe cubes, halved red grapes, chopped tarragon, and torn spearmint.
Drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil and freshly cracked black pepper.
Toss gently and serve cool.
tips: A touch of peppery extra-virgin olive oil makes sweet melon taste crisp and complex.
Zero cooking on hot afternoons.

recipes.title: Silky Extra-Virgin Olive Oil, Celery Stalk, Sage & Thyme Soup
recipes.summary: Velvety dairy-free puree simmering celery stalk and yellow potato with fresh sage, thyme, black pepper, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Soften chopped celery stalk, minced sage, and thyme in 1 tbsp olive oil 4 minutes.
Add diced potato, broth, and black pepper; simmer gently 12 minutes until fork-tender.
Blend silky smooth while streaming in remaining extra-virgin olive oil for lush sheen.
tips: Streaming olive oil into hot soup while blending creates cream-like velvet without dairy.
Soothing and spoonable.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Olive Oil-Braised Chicken, Summer Savory & Barley
recipes.summary: Tender diced chicken gently braised in extra-virgin olive oil and broth with celery stalk, pearl barley, summer savory, rosemary, and black pepper.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk, summer savory, and rosemary in 1.5 tbsp olive oil 4 minutes.
Add diced chicken, black pepper, cooked barley, and broth; cover and simmer gently 12 minutes until tender.
Plate warm and finish with remaining fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Summer savory adds gentle Tuscan warmth to olive-oil braised poultry.
Everything stays soft in one skillet.

recipes.title: Olive Oil Roasted Salmon with Blistered Cherries, Thyme & Orange
recipes.summary: Flaky salmon fillets baked with sweet dark cherries, fresh thyme, orange juice, black pepper, and rich extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Toss halved cherries with 1 tbsp olive oil, orange juice, thyme, and black pepper in a baking dish.
Nestle salmon fillets among the cherries, drizzle with remaining olive oil, and bake at 375°F for 13 to 14 minutes.
Spoon warm jammy cherry-olive oil pan sauce over the flaky fish.
tips: Roasted cherries merge with olive oil into a naturally velvety sauce.
Minimal prep and cleanup.

recipes.title: Provençal Olive Oil, Saffron, Fennel Seed & Celery Cod Braise
recipes.summary: Delicate cod gently simmered in golden olive oil and saffron broth with celery stalk, crushed fennel seed, thyme, and sweet orange zest.
steps: Soften sliced celery stalk, crushed fennel seed, and thyme in 1.5 tbsp olive oil 4 minutes.
Add vegetable broth and saffron threads, simmering 3 minutes, then nestle cod fillets in and cover for 7 minutes.
Finish with orange zest and remaining extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Classic coastal Provençal flavors that keep white fish buttery and delicate.
Serve with soft pearl barley.

recipes.title: Warm Olive Oil-Braised Chickpeas with Turmeric, Nigella & Cilantro
recipes.summary: Cozy Mediterranean-Spiced chickpeas simmered in olive oil and broth with diced celery stalk, turmeric, cumin, black pepper, toasted nigella seed, and cilantro.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk in 1.5 tbsp olive oil 3 minutes, then bloom turmeric, cumin, and black pepper.
Add chickpeas and broth, simmering 10 minutes and lightly mashing a scoop of chickpeas for velvety body.
Plate warm, drizzle with remaining extra-virgin olive oil, and scatter cilantro and nigella seeds.
tips: Generous olive oil turns simple chickpeas into a rich, deeply satisfying stew.
Soft and easy to spoon.

recipes.title: Olive Oil Roasted Squash, Blistered Grape, Sage & Barley Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender roasted butternut squash and juicy red grapes tossed with extra-virgin olive oil, minced sage, cinnamon, black pepper, and warm pearl barley.
steps: Toss small-diced squash with 1 tbsp olive oil, minced sage, cinnamon, and black pepper and roast at 400°F for 14 minutes.
Add halved red grapes to the pan for the final 4 minutes until burst and glossy.
Fold into warm cooked pearl barley with remaining extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Sweet roasted squash and grapes shine with peppery extra-virgin olive oil.
Wholesome, soft vegetarian dinner.

recipes.title: Silky Olive Oil, Sweet Orange, Banana, Turmeric & Ginger Smoothie
recipes.summary: Creamy golden Mediterranean smoothie uniting fruity olive oil, peeled sweet orange, frozen banana, golden turmeric, grated ginger, and a pinch of black pepper.
steps: Blend oat milk, peeled sweet orange, frozen banana, turmeric, grated ginger, and a tiny pinch of black pepper until smooth.
Add fruity olive oil and pulse 3 seconds to whip into silky froth.
Serve chilled right away.
tips: Fruity olive oil blends cleanly with citrus and golden turmeric.
Creamy and bright with zero dairy.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Olive Oil, Blueberry, Sweet Basil & Banana Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety violet smoothie blending wild blueberries, ripe banana, tender sweet basil, Greek yogurt, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Blend milk, Greek yogurt, frozen blueberries, banana, and fresh sweet basil leaves until completely smooth.
Add fruity extra-virgin olive oil and pulse 3 seconds.
Pour chilled and enjoy immediately.
tips: Fresh basil and fruity olive oil give blueberry smoothies a bright garden polish.
Lush and antioxidant-rich.

recipes.title: Olive Oil, Dark Chocolate, Sweet Cherry & Cinnamon Velvet Shake
recipes.summary: Rich silky smoothie pairing finely chopped 70% dark chocolate, frozen dark cherries, ground cinnamon, oat milk, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Blend oat milk, frozen dark cherries, chopped dark chocolate, and cinnamon until silky.
Add extra-virgin olive oil and pulse 3 seconds to create glossy richness.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Inspired by classic olive-oil chocolate mousse—smooth, lush, and dairy-free.
Naturally sweetened by sweet cherries.

recipes.title: Oleato-Style Olive Oil, Iced Coffee, Soft Barley & Banana Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety cafe-style iced coffee shake blending chilled coffee, soft cooked barley, frozen banana, a whisper of anise seed, and extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Blend chilled coffee, oat milk, soft cooked barley, frozen banana, and ground anise seed 50 seconds until smooth.
Add extra-virgin olive oil and pulse 3 seconds for creamy foam.
Pour cold and enjoy immediately.
tips: Olive oil whips into coffee like velvety micro-foam.
Use decaf coffee anytime.

recipes.title: Sunlit Olive Oil, Cantaloupe, Spearmint & Lemon Balm Smoothie
recipes.summary: Cooling Mediterranean melon smoothie blending sweet cantaloupe, fresh spearmint, lemon balm, peeled celery stalk, and fruity olive oil.
steps: Blend cold water, chilled cantaloupe, peeled celery stalk, spearmint, and lemon balm 60 seconds until ultra-smooth.
Add fruity olive oil and pulse 3 seconds.
Serve chilled right away.
tips: Melon and olive oil emulsify into a silky spa-style drink.
Light, cooling, and hydrating.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Olive Oil, Orange, Turmeric & Ginger Vitality Press
recipes.summary: Bright golden wellness press whisking fruity extra-virgin olive oil into strained fresh orange juice, grated ginger, turmeric, and a tiny crack of black pepper.
steps: Stir fresh orange juice, grated ginger, turmeric, and a tiny pinch of black pepper, then strain smoothly through a fine sieve.
Whisk in fruity extra-virgin olive oil briskly for 10 seconds.
Pour into chilled glasses and enjoy right away.
tips: Olive oil pairs naturally with orange carotenoids and golden turmeric.
Crisp, sunlit flavor.

recipes.title: Chilled Olive Oil, Cantaloupe, Green Grape & Sweet Basil Press
recipes.summary: Refreshing Mediterranean melon press combining sweet cantaloupe, green grapes, and sweet basil, whisked lightly with fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Blend cantaloupe, green grapes, and sweet basil leaves 30 seconds.
Strain cleanly through a fine-mesh sieve into a chilled pitcher.
Whisk in fruity olive oil briefly and serve immediately.
tips: Like a chilled sweet green gazpacho tonic—bright, pure, and silky.
Zero added water needed.

recipes.title: Crisp Olive Oil, Celery Stalk, Raspberry & Spearmint Tonic
recipes.summary: Ruby-crisp pressed garden tonic combining celery stalk, raspberries, orange juice, and spearmint with a delicate whisk of fruity olive oil.
steps: Blend chopped celery stalk, fresh raspberries, orange juice, and spearmint 35 seconds.
Press thoroughly through a fine-mesh sieve to catch all raspberry seeds and fibers.
Whisk in fruity olive oil briefly and serve cold.
tips: Straining produces a jewel-clear, super smooth sipper.
Delicate olive oil rounds out tart raspberry.

recipes.title: Chilled Olive Oil, Blueberry, Rosemary & Black Tea Infusion
recipes.summary: Botanical Mediterranean iced tea uniting mild black tea, strained blueberries, a whisper of steeped rosemary, orange juice, and fruity olive oil.

ingredient_details.note: briefly steeped in tea and strained

steps: Steep a small sprig of rosemary in mild black tea 2 minutes, remove, and chill completely.
Blend fresh blueberries, orange juice, and 1/2 cup chilled rosemary black tea, then strain smoothly into remaining tea.
Whisk in fruity olive oil briefly and serve chilled.
tips: Just 2 minutes of rosemary steeping gives refined Mediterranean aroma without piney bitterness.
Use decaf black tea in the evening.

recipes.title: Velvet Olive Oil, Dark Cherry, Shiso & Barley Water Press
recipes.summary: Silky ruby tonic pairing strained dark cherries, fragrant shiso, and chilled barley water emulsified gently with extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Blend pitted cherries, orange juice, fresh shiso, and 1/2 cup chilled barley water 30 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into remaining barley water.
Whisk in extra-virgin olive oil briskly and pour chilled.
tips: Barley water keeps fruity olive oil smoothly suspended in ruby cherry juice.
Naturally soothing and vibrant.
